## About
Skycrest Auto Service is a general repair shop on Drew Street in Clearwater, where each technician has his own area of specialty. We work on all brands of cars, foreign and domestic, and keep old service manuals and original wiring diagrams on hand for older vehicles.
Our promise is simple: be honest and fair, friendly and helpful. One longtime customer put it this way: you can trust Kim to be fair and honest about what needs to be done. Another said we showed them the issues on their car directly before doing the work.
We believe following your manufacturer's maintenance schedule will help your car last. Neighbors have rated us 4.7 from 84 reviews on Google.

## Services
- Official Intoxalock location: We're an official Intoxalock location. Stop by or call with questions about your device.
- Oil changes, Transmission Service, Radiator Flush: Routine maintenance to keep your car running the way it should.
- All Diagnostic Trouble Codes: Engine light on? Don't just check the fluids and call it okay. Bring it in and we'll find the trouble code.
- Brakes - Regular or Antilock Systems: Regular and antilock brake systems.
- Heating and Air Conditioning: Heating and air conditioning repair.
- Transmissions - Automatic or Manual: Automatic or manual, we work on both.
- Radiators: We test and replace radiators on all cars.
- Any kind of Electrical Repair: If it's electrical, we'll track it down and fix it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on all brands of cars, foreign and domestic, old or new.

Q: Do you charge for an estimate?
A: No. Estimates are free.

Q: What if my car won't make it to the shop?
A: Towing service is available through Nationwide Towing or Kotakis Towing. Give us a call and we'll get you their numbers.

Q: Are you open over lunch?
A: On weekdays we take a lunch break starting at 12:00 P.M., so plan your drop-off around it.
